intelligence.description: Infrastructure for long-horizon AI agents, persistent sandboxes, and efficient inference.
company: Sail Research provides infrastructure for long-horizon AI agents, including persistent environments and telemetry intended to let agents work over hours or days. The company argues that this workload needs different infrastructure than short, turn-by-turn model interactions.
In June 2026, Sail announced $80 million of seed and Series A funding at a $450 million valuation. Sequoia led the seed and Kleiner Perkins led the Series A.
